Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our SIG questionnaire — attached is the partial SIGQ (procureco_SIG_v3.1.pdf) with a few open items our security team flagged. Two areas we need clarification on ASAP so we can finish our internal risk review:

1) Data residency & segregation: we need confirmation of where customer data (request/response logs, KV cache artifacts) may be stored for both Hosted and Dedicated deployments. Can you enumerate regions and any downstream replicas?

2) Key custody & KMS: our procurement requires either customer-managed keys (BYOK) with HSM-backed KMS or a documented control rationale for Redwood-managed keys in hosted mode. Please confirm which modes are supported, whether Redwood has an HSM attestation, and a sample key-rotation record we can review.

We also attached a rough timeline for our procurement (we're targeting vendor selection by 4/30). If you can get answers plus the control-evidence index and a simple network/system diagram, that will help speed our internal approvals.

Hi Jane — thanks for the pointer and the attached questionnaire. We're happy to run through the open items.

High level answers up front:
- Data residency: For Hosted customers we offer region-specific tenancy (US, EU) and do not replicate customer logs outside the selected region unless specifically requested for cross-region failover. For Dedicated and Private deployments customers control region placement (we install into your VPC/region).
- Keys/KMS: Redwood supports two modes: Redwood-managed keys (hosted) or customer-managed KMS via Redwood Private with HSM-backed key stores (BYOK). We can provide key-rotation artifacts for audit.

Proposed mutual action plan (we can iterate):
- We (Redwood): deliver control-evidence index CSV, a sanitized system-architecture diagram, SOC 2 summary page, and an example key-rotation artifact.
- ProcureCo: confirm which deployment mode you're evaluating (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private) and any retention windows that differ from default.

Can Karthik and Marissa join a 30–45m call Thursday (4/13) or Monday (4/17) for a technical walkthrough? If you confirm a time I’ll send a calendar invite and include a shared Drive link for the evidence bundle.

I’ll start pulling the evidence index — expect a follow-up from me with the CSV and a diagram by EOD Friday.

Hi Jane — looping in detailed answers below (pulled from our controls & deployment docs). I’ll attach the artifacts after we receive the NDA: control-evidence-index.csv, system-architecture-diagram.png, and a sanitized key-rotation record.

Short answers:
- Retention: We can accommodate 13 months of request/response logs for an enterprise commitment (Dedicated or Private). For Hosted customers we offer a configuration option for 13 months on request; we treat this as a contractual exception and it will be reflected in the SOW.

- Key custody & KMS modes (detailed):
  * Hosted (Redwood-managed): Redwood manages keys in our KMS. Keys are HSM-backed via our cloud provider's KMS (we maintain attestation evidence). Rotation cadence is configurable; we can provide redacted rotation logs showing timestamps, key IDs (redacted), and rotation operator. This is suitable for lower-compliance workloads.
  * Dedicated: Customer data is isolated to dedicated GPU pools and dedicated tenancy. Optionally, we can integrate with customer KMS via network peering to allow customer-controlled keys for certain material (e.g., sealing keys).
  * Private (VPC/on-prem): Full BYOK is supported. Customers can bring HSM-backed KMS (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Key Vault HSM) or use on-prem HSMs; we support key-wrapping and do not store unwrapped customer keys.

- HSM attestation & evidence: We maintain copies of our cloud KMS attestation and our SOC 2 report sections relevant to key management. We'll provide the attestation summary (redacted) as part of the evidence bundle.

Next steps:
1) Karthik — please send the DocuSign NDA link to jane.dawson@procureco.com.
2) Jane — once NDA executes, we’ll share the control-evidence-index.csv and the redacted artifacts (expected within 24 hours).
3) Kim & Marissa — we'll run the technical deep-dive 4/17 09:00 PT; agenda to cover dataflow, KV cache persistence, retention settings, and key custody modes.
